run_classification_policy.summary: Every run_state artifact carries a run_classification block. Scheduled runs of the repaired live task 10ce362c (which supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b; artifact root stays under .../ce16ba6b for continuity) write under scheduled_runs/YYYYMMDD_1520ET/ and update latest_scheduled_run.json; manual runs write under manual_runs/<timestamp>/ and never touch that pointer. Every scheduled 3:20 PM ET run_state MUST include BOTH run_classification.cron_id='10ce362c' AND run_classification.supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b'; placeholder/ambiguous ids like 'ce16ba6b_replacement' are forbidden. For continuity, downstream analytics accept a scheduled run as valid evidence when cron_id='10ce362c' OR supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b'. Downstream analytics validate scheduled state, exclude all manual order IDs and any run_origin='manual'/manual_run=true state, and never infer scheduled status from broker orders alone.

base_amount_policy.summary: The graded DCA base amount is exactly $3.00; every candidate dollar amount equals $3.00 x multiplier. Never infer, discover, or fall back to $50.00 or any broker/account default base amount. If the base-amount config is missing or unreadable, continue using $3.00 and record base_amount_source='hardcoded_user_confirmed_3_usd'.

tasks.notes: Primary afternoon trading task. This is the repaired live task 10ce362c, which supersedes the deleted ce16ba6b; the artifact root stays under .../ce16ba6b for continuity. Approved live Robinhood execution using the $3 base 0x-to-5x ladder with tiered daily/weekly caps. Robinhood account 562057042 only; Alpaca read-only. Places real market buy orders automatically within safeguards; must not fall back to interactive confirmation. A SCHEDULED run writes run_state.json (with run_classification run_origin='scheduled', run_type='scheduled_live_test', manual_run=false, scheduled_for_et='15:20', run_id='scheduled_YYYYMMDD_1520ET', and BOTH cron_id='10ce362c' AND supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b') under scheduled_runs/YYYYMMDD_1520ET/ AND updates latest_scheduled_run.json. Placeholder/ambiguous ids such as 'ce16ba6b_replacement' are forbidden; for continuity, consumers still accept cron_id='10ce362c' OR supersedes_cron_id='ce16ba6b' as valid evidence. The scheduled run_state is ALWAYS written even when no order is placed; a confirmation-blocked run records order_submit_status='not_submitted_confirmation_required', reviewed_order details, candidate details, and no order_id, and remains valid scheduled-run evidence (but not order/fill evidence). A MANUAL run writes run_state.json (run_origin='manual', manual_run=true, distinct run_id) under manual_runs/<timestamp>/ and MUST NOT update latest_scheduled_run.json. Same-day morning live fills (morning-dca-0945) are consumed only as prior same-day allocation context for this task's same-day top-up guard: incremental_order_amount=max(0, desired_amount - prior_same_day_amount), and when earlier same-day buys exist the task buys only if the current price is strictly below the prior-run reference price.
